partners.mechanism_chain: MEFV pathogenic variant —DISRUPTS→ MEFV (HGNC:7025); MEFV (HGNC:7025) —DECREASES→ Pyrin inflammasome assembly and activation; Pyrin inflammasome assembly and activation —DECREASES→ IL-1beta (CHEBI:50043); IL-1beta (CHEBI:50043) —LEADS_TO→ Recurrent fever (HP:0012419); NLRP3 pathogenic variant —DISRUPTS→ NLRP3 (HGNC:30829); NLRP3 (HGNC:30829) —DECREASES→ Pyrin inflammasome assembly and activation; IL-1beta (CHEBI:50043) —LEADS_TO→ Recurrent corneal inflammation (HP:0031197). Pathogenic variants in MEFV (autosomal recessive FMF) and NLRP3 (Keratitis Fugax Hereditaria) both lead to impaired function of the pyrin inflammasome complex. This impaired function results in reduced production of IL-1beta, which paradoxically leads to dysregulated inflammatory responses manifesting as recurrent fever in FMF and recurrent corneal inflammation in KFH. The convergence occurs at the level of the NLRP3 inflammasome pathway, where dysregulation of its components, either directly (NLRP3) or indirectly via upstream regulators (MEFV's role in pyrin function), leads to similar downstream consequences of aberrant inflammation.

#### 1. keratitis fugax hereditaria  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.473)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-844456, Reactome:R-HSA-9660826)

**Proposed mechanism:** MEFV pathogenic variant —DISRUPTS→ MEFV (HGNC:7025); MEFV (HGNC:7025) —DECREASES→ Pyrin inflammasome assembly and activation; Pyrin inflammasome assembly and activation —DECREASES→ IL-1beta (CHEBI:50043); IL-1beta (CHEBI:50043) —LEADS_TO→ Recurrent fever (HP:0012419); NLRP3 pathogenic variant —DISRUPTS→ NLRP3 (HGNC:30829); NLRP3 (HGNC:30829) —DECREASES→ Pyrin inflammasome assembly and activation; IL-1beta (CHEBI:50043) —LEADS_TO→ Recurrent corneal inflammation (HP:0031197). Pathogenic variants in MEFV (autosomal recessive FMF) and NLRP3 (Keratitis Fugax Hereditaria) both lead to impaired function of the pyrin inflammasome complex. This impaired function results in reduced production of IL-1beta, which paradoxically leads to dysregulated inflammatory responses manifesting as recurrent fever in FMF and recurrent corneal inflammation in KFH. The convergence occurs at the level of the NLRP3 inflammasome pathway, where dysregulation of its components, either directly (NLRP3) or indirectly via upstream regulators (MEFV's role in pyrin function), leads to similar downstream consequences of aberrant inflammation.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of a pathogenic variant in MEFV or NLRP3 associated with the respective disease that demonstrably leads to a gain-of-function effect in the inflammasome pathway, or if independent genetic studies reveal no overlap in the affected pathways or cellular processes between the two diseases. _(variant: rs748209360 (a known pathogenic variant in MEFV, often associated with FMF) found at >1% frequency in relevant populations would challenge its role as a rare causal variant for FMF.)_

**Why it matters:** Targeting the NLRP3 inflammasome pathway, for instance with IL-1beta inhibitors, could potentially offer therapeutic benefits for both Familial Mediterranean Fever and Keratitis Fugax Hereditaria, suggesting a common therapeutic strategy for diseases with distinct clinical presentations but shared underlying pathway dysregulation.
